This page describes cited portions of level-up and progression logic in original prose.

Thresholds, counters, and base parameters are separate claims from the runtime effect of a level-up. A summary does not establish cap behavior, rounding, rewards, or interactions unless the evidence explicitly supports them.

Related numeric facts retain their own evidence and confidence labels. Missing conditions are not replaced by a guessed progression formula.
